candidate_description: TF-IDF (1-2gram, 30k max_features, sublinear_tf, min_df=2) + LogisticRegression (C=1.0, balanced class_weight, max_iter=2000)
contamination_statement: Training used W11 train only and tuning used validation only. However, test, frozen_adversarial, and owner_golden were opened before the mandatory second pretrained encoder comparison was completed, so this is not a completed final-selection freeze. Do not tune against those observed held-outs. If the selected candidate, preprocessing, thresholds, or configuration changes, the observed held-outs become development evidence and a new/versioned unseen acceptance set is required for an unbiased final claim.
selection_rationale: Baseline decisively outperformed bert-tiny on validation: 91.9% vs 67.8% label accuracy, 0.844 vs 0.443 macro F1. Critical slices: gameplay BLOCK FP rate 1.8% vs 9.1% (5x better), threat recall 92.7% vs 96.4% (bert-tiny slightly better but at unacceptable FP cost). bert-mini training incomplete due to compute/time constraints (killed after 22min, 2 CPU host). Selection based on complete product risk profile, not aggregate F1 alone.

thresholds.note: Provisional default argmax/0.5 behavior recorded before held-out evaluation. Final W12 acceptance still requires validation-only calibration/threshold rationale after the mandatory candidate comparison; do not use observed held-outs to choose thresholds.
